title: Great reach, painful fees
text: Easy to set up an event and the discovery is useful.
dislikes: The fees are way too high for our nonprofit and they cut into our margins on every ticket. We pass them on to attendees and get complaints at checkout. Payouts also come only after the event, which hurts our cash flow.
author: Priya N.

title: Can't make it look like our brand
text: We run three festivals a year.
dislikes: Very limited customization. You cannot white-label the event page, so it always feels like we are borrowing their space. Buyers see their logo, not ours, and their emails promote other events to our attendees. We are looking for an alternative.
author: Marcus T.

title: Solid but no UPI
dislikes: Doesn't support UPI or Razorpay, so a lot of our Indian buyers drop off at payment. Our attendees keep asking for UPI. Support replies are slow too.
author: Arjun S.

title: Bought tickets, event was fake
text: I bought two tickets for a concert and the event did not exist. Eventbrite wouldn't refund me. Total scam.
author: Dave L.

title: Payout on hold for my own event
text: As an organizer I ran my own event and after the event they put my payout on hold and asked for documentation to prove legitimacy. Funds withheld for weeks, terrible for cash flow. I will not use them again.
author: Sana K.

title: Does the job
dislikes: We can't export the attendee data easily and cannot retarget our own buyers. Reporting is basic and check-in app crashed during our last race.
author: Rohan M.

title: Fees went up again
text: We host weekly workshops for our clients.
dislikes: Hidden costs everywhere: service charge, processing fee, and now a subscription tier, so it feels like paying twice. Fees keep going up and our margins are gone.
author: Hannah R.

title: Okay for small shows
text: We use it for club nights.
dislikes: Missing features like seat maps and WhatsApp reminders. App is slow at check-in on busy nights.
author: Omar A.

title: Support is useless
text: Nobody replied to my email about my tickets for three days. Worst customer support. Bought tickets and the QR was invalid at the door.
author: Meera J.
